_purpose: OPERATOR REFERENCE ONLY. Per the intake anti-pattern lock, this audit is never design DNA. The owl template + gilroy-roofing.vercel.app reference are the sole sources of layout and styling. Nothing in this file may seed tokens.css or design_reference.json.
strengths: Strong, real hero photograph — a roofer nailing shingles, shot close. More convincing than the generic house-exterior stock most competitors run.
Value proposition is stated plainly in the hero and is the right one: 'We handle insurance claims so you don't have to.'
Gold-on-near-black is genuinely distinctive in this vertical, where almost everyone runs blue or red.
Phone number and a primary CTA are both above the fold, and the phone is in the sticky header.
Trust row under the CTA (Licensed & Insured / rating / Same Day Response) is the right idea and the right position.
weaknesses: Rating claims contradict each other across the site — homepage '5.0 / 100+ Reviews', reviews page '5.0 / 127 reviews'. A prospect who notices this loses trust in every other number on the page.
Three service images are hotlinked from other contractors' websites (premiersouthla.com, powerwashri.com, idahoguttercompany.com). Legal exposure, plus the images break if those sites change.
Emoji are used as interface icons throughout (envelope, pin, star, shield, lightning, phone). They render inconsistently across platforms and read as unfinished.
The primary CTA is an address-based 'Instant Estimate' tool. It promises an accurate roof quote 'in under 60 seconds', which is a hard promise to keep and sets up disappointment.
Testimonials are labelled 'Website testimonial' with no platform attribution — unverifiable, and weaker than the real named third-party reviews that exist elsewhere.
Service sections are one paragraph each with no dedicated pages, so there is nothing ranking for 'roof repair Kennesaw' or any other service+city term.
Service areas are listed as flat text under county headings with no pages behind them — same missed-search problem.
No FAQ content anywhere on the site.
what_the_new_site_fixes: Seven real service pages and seven service-area pages, each with its own copy — replacing flat text lists.
Real named, dated third-party reviews replacing unattributed website testimonials.
No unverified rating or review count printed anywhere.
Locally hosted imagery only; the three hotlinked competitor images are dropped.
An FAQ section built around the actual Georgia homeowner worries surfaced in local research.

logo_reference.note: Observed in the header of the existing site — used ONLY to rebuild the client's own mark as clean SVG, not as layout inspiration.
logo_reference.structure: Rounded-square gold tile containing a dark infinity glyph, set left of a two-line wordmark: 'INFINITY' in large display caps, 'ROOFING & CLEANING' beneath in small letterspaced caps.
